{
  "group": "Message.getGeneratedTSIG() behavior",
  "cases": [
    {
      "input": [],
      "expected": "null",
      "description": "When a newly constructed Message has never had a TSIG set, getGeneratedTSIG() should return null."
    },
    {
      "input": [],
      "expected": "TSIGRecord instance with the same key name, algorithm, and MAC as the TSIG key provided to setTSIG(TSIG)",
      "description": "After calling setTSIG(TSIG key) on the Message, getGeneratedTSIG() must return the TSIGRecord that was generated by the setTSIG call. The returned record should contain the TSIG key information supplied."
    },
    {
      "input": [],
      "expected": "TSIGRecord instance whose error field equals the error code passed to setTSIG(TSIG, int, TSIGRecord)",
      "description": "When setTSIG(TSIG key, int error, TSIGRecord querytsig) is invoked, the Message creates a TSIGRecord reflecting the supplied error code. getGeneratedTSIG() should return that TSIGRecord, allowing verification of the error field."
    },
    {
      "input": [],
      "expected": "null",
      "description": "If setTSIG is called with a null TSIG key, the implementation should leave generatedTsig as null; consequently getGeneratedTSIG() returns null."
    }
  ]
}
